# Ohio State University Libraries

> Ohio State University Libraries provides comprehensive research support, resource discovery, and academic services for the university community through physical locations, digital collections, and specialized research tools.

The Libraries serve as a central hub for scholarly communication, offering access to millions of materials through multiple discovery systems, specialized research facilities like the Research Commons, and expert subject librarian support. Key services include interlibrary loan, course reserves, institutional repository management through Knowledge Bank, and accessibility accommodations.

## Key Topics

- Research Commons
- Knowledge Bank
- Interlibrary Loan
- Course Reserves
- Subject Librarians
- Special Collections
- GIS Mapping
- Citation Guides (APA, MLA, Chicago)
- Data Management
- Records Management
- Thompson Library
- OhioLINK
- Article Express
- Information Literacy
- Accessibility Services

## Getting Started

- [Ohio State University Libraries Homepage](https://library.osu.edu): Main portal with services, resources, and initiatives overview.
- [Find and Borrow](https://library.osu.edu/find-and-borrow): Resource discovery and borrowing guide for library materials and collections.
- [Find Materials](https://library.osu.edu/find-what-you-need): Guide to finding materials via Libraries Search, OhioLINK, and SearchOhio.
- [Ask Us](https://library.osu.edu/askus): 24/7 support via LibAnswers and LibGuides with research assistance and FAQs.

## Research Support & Tools

- [Research and Tools](https://library.osu.edu/research-and-tools): Research support via Research Commons, Knowledge Bank, and subject guides.
- [Research Commons](https://library.osu.edu/locations/researchcommons): Research Commons facility with data visualization, GIS mapping, and AI support.
- [Knowledge Bank](https://library.osu.edu/kb): Institutional repository for open-access scholarly communication and preservation.
- [Research Help](https://library.osu.edu/research-help): Research coaching with citation guides (APA, MLA, Chicago) and data management.
- [Subject Librarians](https://library.osu.edu/subject-librarians): Directory of subject librarians providing specialized research support.

## Collections & Special Materials

- [Special Collections](https://library.osu.edu/special-collections): Special Collections including archives, rare books, and cultural heritage materials.
- [Borrowing and Lending](https://library.osu.edu/borrowing-and-lending): Borrowing policies, interlibrary loan, course reserves, and account management.

## Services & Support

- [Services](https://library.osu.edu/libraries-services): Overview of library services including room reservations and subject librarians.
- [Teaching & Course Support](https://library.osu.edu/teaching): Faculty resources for course support, instruction, and information literacy.
- [Accessibility Resources](https://library.osu.edu/accessibility-resources): Accessibility services, assistive technology, and disability accommodations.

## Administration & Compliance

- [Records Management](https://library.osu.edu/osu-records-management): Records management guidance, retention schedules, and compliance training.
- [About Us](https://library.osu.edu/about-us): Organizational overview, mission, vision, and library structure.
